data.authority_boundary: Records describe what occurred and never silently change approved program order, duration, calls, or safety policy.
data.immutability_rule: Once authorized, performance_instance_id, source timestamps, evidence references, and audit identity are append-only; corrections require a linked superseding record.

required_record_contract.performance_instance_id: required immutable reference to an evidence-backed show instance
required_record_contract.actual_duration_seconds: nullable and derived only when supported
required_record_contract.planned_duration_seconds: nullable controlled profile reference, not copied authority
required_record_contract.safety_or_incident_refs: required array; empty only after explicit no-link confirmation

data.unknown_value_rule: Unknown timestamps, durations, variance, reasons, and links remain null; absence is never zero.
data.activation_gate: Requires a registered performance instance, synchronized source clock, provenance, recorder authorization, and applicable incident/safety linkage review before accepting a record.
